verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents Transfer and Dispute webhooks. Its payment-event webhooks notify when a merchant initiates a payment and when funds are added to or deducted from balance accounts, so post-auth money movement and disputes are delivered programmatically. However, the evidence never explicitly names clearing, refund, or reversal events or how they map to the original authorization. missing for 10: explicit documentation of clearing/refund/reversal/chargeback event types, stable transaction identifiers linking post-auth events to the authorization, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ledger reconciliation.
